title: SkyWater Technology
summary: US foundry specialising in defence, rad-hard and specialty process development.
bodyHtml:
SkyWater runs a foundry in Bloomington, Minnesota, with a business built around US government trust, radiation-hardened processes and development work for new technologies.

It offers process development and low-volume production for customers who need domestic fabrication.

Why it matters

  • Trusted foundry for defence
  • Rad-hard and specialty processes
  • Process development services

investmentLens: A listed small-cap foundry with government exposure; revenue is lumpy and capital intensity is high.
